scope: Updated overview, broader series structure, generated site semantics, and current book navigation/changed sections. Not an exhaustive filmography or every-page accessibility certification.

workers.Disha: Synthesis, narrative/coverage audit and shared records

findings.title: Make named performer sections discoverable
findings.evidence: Bijay, Uttam and Aparajita are plain H3 headings without IDs; renderer only anchors H2. Book contents only names the companion survey; new performer/music detail falls after the closing future chapter.
findings.action: Add stable H3 anchors and selected section-menu/hub shortcuts. Add named performer/music contents entries and people-guide pointers. Editorial option: promote a concise performers-and-music chapter into the main narrative before the new-generation section, leaving counts in reference material.
findings.acceptance: Each named profile has a working link; performers and songs can be reached from hub/book contents without searching the full survey.

findings.title: Put the measurement beside each film count
findings.evidence: Mahasweta's Almost40 counts lead-film credits, while other rows report broader film totals. Jayiram's source mixes reporter film count and recalled comic roles. Source qualifications are accurate but easier to overlook than the numbers.
findings.action: Write Almost40 lead-film credits in the estimate cell; separate lead-only and film/role-ambiguous rows from broader film totals or mark the unit directly beside every number. Retain dates and avoid ranking incomparable data.
findings.acceptance: A reader scanning numbers alone cannot reasonably mistake lead roles for total appearances or treat dated reports as current rankings.

findings.title: Keep statistics from interrupting the human narrative
findings.evidence: Three performer capsules lead into five contribution rows and nine count rows before the music story. The overview narrative is approximately5750words. The book count panels occupy several pages between stories and songs.
findings.action: Keep the strongest performer and music stories together; move the count reference after the narrative or into a clearly named reference section with its own shortcut. Preserve all evidence.
findings.acceptance: Readers can follow people to music to newer films without crossing the count reference.

findings.title: Restore continuation before the sources
findings.evidence: On the inspected390px viewport, Footnotes begins around34572px and Next reading around47306px. Working source links do not solve that long traversal.
findings.action: Add a compact next-reading link at the narrative end before source/credit sections; retain expanded sources and bottom navigation.
findings.acceptance: Next reading is available immediately after the story on desktop and mobile.

findings.title: Complete accessibility semantics for the new content
findings.evidence: New verified Odia titles are absent from the reviewed language allowlist; the two performer tables both have generic Scrollable data table names and lack explicit scoped row/column header associations.
findings.action: Add reviewed Odia title language spans; give contribution and count tables distinct accessible captions/names and appropriate scoped headers. Preserve keyboard-contained scrolling.
findings.acceptance: Verified titles expose lang=or; assistive technology can distinguish both tables and associate each figure with performer and unit.

findings.title: Avoid narrowing major performers through headings or statistics
findings.evidence: Mahasweta's leading career sits under Comedy, character work. Siddhanta appears only as a count, without a meaningful work example.
findings.action: Rename the wider selection Other performers and collaborations, keeping comedy as a distinct contribution. Add one sourced Siddhanta performance/collaboration example so the count is connected to work.
findings.acceptance: Leading, character and comic careers receive accurate framing; no actor exists in the overview only as a statistic.

findings.title: Strengthen the missing generational bridge
findings.evidence: Prasanta Nanda is absent from the overview despite the Sesa Srabana discussion; Sarat Pujari already has a concrete Mangaraj credit in the Parbati essay. Tandra Ray remains an unresearched expansion lead.
findings.action: Prioritise sourced work-based connections for Prasanta Nanda, Sarat Pujari and Tandra Ray. Continue standalone Bijay/Uttam/Aparajita pages with distinct rights-cleared portraits; do not pad the story with an unbounded names list.
findings.acceptance: Each addition explains a specific contribution and links to a film or collaboration; absent counts stay unknown.

findings.title: Clarify the two numeric note systems without verbose captions
findings.evidence: Caption superscript13 goes to image credit13; prose13 goes to a chapter source. Both use the requested numbers-only visible form, but print readers lack the web accessible labels.
findings.action: Add one short reading-key explanation for caption numbers versus prose numbers, with page pointers in print. Keep caption markers numeric only; do not restore Photo credit labels.
findings.acceptance: Reader can locate the right note system with no repeated caption boilerplate.

findings.title: Trim editorial scaffolding and repeated closing invitations
findings.evidence: Capsules retain phrases such as useful starting points and belong beside acting in this account. Cinema Futures repeats organise a licensed screening/help a colleague learn in closing paragraphs94 and98.
findings.action: Let verified teaching, mentorship, audience and song-making memories lead. Remove generic explanations of editorial intent and retain one stronger forward-looking closing invitation. Preserve attributed testimony; invent no scenes.
findings.acceptance: Concrete people and work carry the transition, with fewer repetitive instructions to the reader.

findings.title: Reconcile audit receipts and remaining bilingual gaps
findings.evidence: Book-build receipt still says final PDF review pending and retains an older introduction-only edit scope despite current final PASS. LoveMaster and playAmariBhagaban remain English-only because original Odia spelling was not verified.
findings.action: Bind receipt to the actual final independent review and accurate change scope, preserving prior events. Verify the remaining title spellings before adding Odia; don't guess.
findings.acceptance: Current receipts agree with exact reviewed hashes; bilingual status honestly distinguishes completed and unresolved titles.
